title: Preflight Method Flow runner subcommand flags
failure_signature: The first Method Flow append used an unsupported --input flag; argparse stopped before mutating the initialized ledger.
trigger_preconditions: Runner subcommand invoked from memory rather than its exact help contract
Record file existed and the ledger was initialized
Argument parsing occurred before ledger mutation
candidate_workaround: Use the runner's documented --record-file flag and preflight exact subcommand help when an interface has not yet been exercised in the phase.
recurrence_guard: Copy exact runner flags from the current skill implementation or subcommand help; do not infer flag names from adjacent tools.
rollback: No ledger entry or other repository state was changed by the rejected invocation; preserve the failed command as evidence and retry once with the exact flag.
protected_gates: No erasure of tooling failures after recovery
scope_boundary: This method addresses runner invocation accuracy only and proves no scientific, authority, production, deployment, privacy, security, accessibility, identity, personhood, or independent-reproduction claim.
